name: tunnel-keeper
description: Simple desktop utility for AWS SSM port-forwarding tunnels
author: lokemoon

scripts.dist:mac: tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg && tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
scripts.dist:win: tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis && tauri build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:win
